summary: Frontend-only UI verification for the two user-reported items (Turkish) and three follow-ups from iteration_89. Executed live Playwright tests at 360x800, 390x844 and 1920x1080. Primary items (phone ghost mask, green WhatsApp-style mobile phone button) PASS. Flags-at-360 & no-overflow follow-up PASSES. Bank-transfer 3-bank accordion + submitLock double-submit guard verified via code review (Apply.jsx lines 54, 1217/1234/1278, 3042, 3067) — full wizard e2e was not driven due to complexity (requires passport+photo uploads, 3 legal checkboxes, dates and Stripe redirect); the previous iteration_89 already exercised the full wizard and main agent self-verified with Playwright typing.
